Small World3D Engine

High-performance hybrid WebGL2/WebGPU rendering pipeline built in strict TypeScript.

Hybrid Rendering

Optimized Cook-Torrance PBR shading compiled dynamically for both WebGL2 and WebGPU.

🤖

FSM & Behaviors

Zero-allocation Finite State Machine utility natively executing in the recursive update loop.

🎥

Post-Processing Filters

Specialized shader passes for phosphor Night Vision, VHS tracking, glitches, project noises, and Noir film.

📐

Conformal reflections

Mirror geometries, procedural checkerboard maps, and real-time sphere inversion math.

🖱️

Octree Interactions

Built-in DOM-like pointer events (Hover, Click) backed by highly optimized O(log n) Octree raycasting.
